## History

Joseph is a student in Anne's class at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Along with his classmates, he writes composition letters as part of his schoolwork under Anne's instruction.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P4](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0004), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P8](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0008), +20 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--joseph.md)

Joseph is a student taught by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her time as the schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). He interacts with her in the classroom setting, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) collects and reviews compositions written by him and his fellow pupils. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds the work and responses of her students, including Joseph's class, to be a source of amusement.

- Student of  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P18](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0018)</sub>

### [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barbara-shaw--joseph.md)

Joseph is the uncle of [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md). Their familial connection is noted among the background details of the students in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classroom.

- Relative of — uncle  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033)</sub>
